edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner during Owned construction.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership body executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer with msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferAnyERC20Token body executes.
Owned constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
Constructor assigns the fixed symbol string.
Constructor assigns the fixed name string.
Constructor assigns decimals = 18.
Constructor assigns the hard-coded total supply.
Constructor pre-mints the entire supply into balances at a hard-coded address.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply, an unchecked subtraction.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as the subtrahend of an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer debits the sender balance and credits the recipient balance.
transfer delegates the balance debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates the balance credit to safeAdd.
approve stores the allowance in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom debits the from balance and credits the to balance.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance debits to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates the recipient credit to safeAdd.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall stores the allowance before performing the external call.
approveAndCall hands control to an attacker-supplied spender contract through receiveApproval.
The external callee retains control flow and can re-enter token functions before the call returns.
Allowance state written just before the external call remains mutable by the re-entrant callee.
transferAnyERC20Token calls into an arbitrary ERC20 contract's transfer function.
The external ERC20 contract returns control to transferAnyERC20Token, whose return value is forwarded.
The swept tokens are sent to the privileged owner address inside the external call arguments.
